eyebrow.zh: 本地 · 零出口 · 可审计 · 单文件
eyebrow.en: On-prem · Zero egress · Auditable · Single file

headline.zh:
一条命令
在内网 GPU 盒上跑编码 Agent
headline.en:
Run a coding agent
on your in-network GPU box

sub.zh: 数据不出境的国企研发，第一次像用云端 runner 一样顺手——连 agent 的 shell 命令都出不了这台盒子，每一次外发请求都留痕可审。
sub.en: On-prem R&D that finally feels like a cloud runner — even the agent's shell commands can't leave the box, and every outbound request is logged and audit-ready.

hero.command: airtap run "给 server.go 加 /health 接口"

title.zh: 连 agent 的 shell 命令都出不了这台盒子
title.en: Even the agent's shell commands can't leave the box

body.zh: agent 跑的每一条 shell 命令，都在一个没有出口的隔离网络里执行——curl、wget、nc 都拨不出去；盒子若没法这样隔离，命令干脆不跑，绝不留后门。
body.en: Every shell command the agent runs executes inside an isolated network with no way out — curl, wget, nc can't dial off the box; if the box can't enforce that isolation, the command simply won't run. No back door left open.

title.zh: 没有审计记录，就不放行任何外发

body.zh: 每一次放行与拒绝都写进审计日志；万一审计写不下去（磁盘满、日志损坏），那次拨号直接拒绝——你看到的「零出口」才经得起查。
body.en: Every allow and deny is written to the audit log; if a record can't be made (disk full, broken log), that dial is refused outright — so the "zero egress" you see can stand up to an audit.

title.zh: 你允许的工具，才是真正会跑的工具
title.en: The tools you allow are the tools that run

body.zh: 在 airtap.yaml 里写 tools:[read]，agent 就真的只能读——写、list、bash 一概不跑；模型也只调盒上的国产模型，不经任何云。你写的约束，就是执行的约束。
body.en: Write tools:[read] in airtap.yaml and the agent really can only read — write, list, bash stay off; the model only ever calls the on-box domestic model, no cloud in the path. The constraint you write is the constraint that runs.

title.zh: 按 Ctrl-C 就停，一条命令就装好
title.en: Ctrl-C stops it, one command installs it

body.zh: 卡住的拨号、静默的生成都能被 Ctrl-C 即时打断；安装也不用先搭编译环境，一条命令拉下来就能跑。
body.en: A stuck dial, a quiet generation — Ctrl-C breaks out at once; and you install it without setting up a build environment, one command pulls it down and you're running.

headline.zh: 在内网 GPU 盒上开始
headline.en: Start on your in-network GPU box

sub.zh: 一条命令上手，零云上出口。
